The '''skirmish at Outpost D-34''' took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. It resulted in the capture of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] stowed away aboard the ''[[Onece 3]]''.

==Prelude==
Following the recent [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Rebel defeat]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traffic began to increase in the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]]. Imperial Intelligence suspected a connection and believed that the Rebels would try to pass through this checkpoint. One of their pilots, [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]], who had been stationed there following [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mordon (Human)|Mordon's]] death would prove that hypothesis.

==Battle==
{{Quote|Incoming ships! They are entering the area near buoy B-18.|[[Outpost D-34]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
===Inspection===
{{Quote|Warning! Illegal cargo located on one of the freighters.|[[Outpost D-34]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
Two ship groups, [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] group [[Onece group|Onece]] and [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transport]] group [[Dayta group|Dayta]] arrived and requested permission to pass through the sector. While attempting to pass through [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] began to inspect the ships starting with the transports, which he found had workers, he then inspected the freighters to discover that Rebels were hiding in freighter [[Onece 3]], while the rest contained [[Foodstuff/Legends|Foodstuffs]], He alerted his senior officers, to which transports [[Sigma group|Sigma]] were then dispatched to disable and capture the freighter.

===Shuttle intervention===
{{Quote|The incoming shuttles have not identified themselves.|[[Outpost D-34]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]|<ref name="TF" />}}
While Sigma group and Stele attacked the freighter, Rebel [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Shuttles]] arrived in an attempt to intervene to save the Rebels from being captured. They were unsuccessful as by the time they arrived Stele managed to help drain the shields and slightly damaging the hull of Onece 3. Transport Sigma disabled Onece 3 forcing it to stop and [[Sigma 1]] boarded it to capture the freighter while [[Sigma 2]] returned to base. Stele engaged both shuttle groups [[Roe group|Roe]] and [[Escro group|Escro]] were all destroyed by him. The freighter was then boarded, captured and was sent to a Imperial shipyard, where the rebels would be interrogated. The rest of the freighter convoy, which carried cargo that matched their manifests claims were allowed to go and therefore entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] bound for parts unknown. Another convoy that arrived was [[Container transport|Container Transport]] group [[Taloos group|Taloos]] and [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] group [[Yander group|Yander]]. Both carried legal cargoes and were allowed to pass.

==Aftermath==
The captured freighter carried 10 individuals, some of them were [[Mugaari]] sympathisers. Imperial Intelligence hoped to learn more about the Rebel activity in the sector through the prisoners. Admiral [[Flanken]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Thorbo]] were the ones who interrogated the prisoners for the desired base of operations and plans using an [[Interrogation droid/Legends|Interrogation droid]] to extract every detail they could get. To Stele it reminded him of being a [[Bordal]]i [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]], but figured that it served the Rebels right.

Another thing was that Alliance forces in the area upon hearing the unsuccessful smuggle attempt believed that if they could not smuggle their forces out of this sector, they may have to force their way out. This would lead to the [[Defense of Outpost D-34|First Battle of Javin]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Skirmish on Outpost D-34 first appears in the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] game [[1994]] [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]. This is Battle 1 mission 1 in the game. The details of Stele's specific actions are in TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide.

This is the storyline of the mission following "medium" difficulty. If the player tries hard difficulty then the first shuttle group is replaced with [[Ravtin group|Ravtin]] and [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle|Escort shuttle]] group [[Tough group|Tough]] there is also a stormtrooper transport called [[Glich]] which must be destroyed as a "bonus" objective. The strategy guide acknowledges the Transport Glich.
